About JD Frontier

Who We Are

JD Frontier is the authorised dealer of Jiadi submersible pumps in Pakistan. We import genuine water submersible pumps directly from China and supply them across Pakistan from our base on City Saddar Road, Rawalpindi.

Jiadi has manufactured submersible pumps and motors since 1988 and exports to more than 70 countries. Through JD Frontier, Pakistani homes, farms, housing societies and industries get the same factory-original pumps — with local stock, local pricing and local support.

Why Choose JD Frontier

  • 100% genuine products — imported directly from the Jiadi factory, no copies or refurbished units.
  • Full range in stock — 2" to 6" deep well pumps, borehole, screw, peripheral, drainage, sewage and solar submersible pumps.
  • Built for Pakistan — pumps suited to deep water tables, voltage fluctuation and solar-powered irrigation.
  • Expert guidance — we help you pick the right head, flow and motor size for your bore so you don't overspend.
  • Warranty & after-sales service — local support and genuine spare parts when you need them.
  • Dealer & bulk pricing — competitive rates for contractors, resellers and project orders.

Our Promise

Reliable water, every day. Whether it's a household tube well in Rawalpindi or a solar irrigation system in the field, we stand behind every pump we sell.
